items.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024
items.q: I composed all the music, I did some of the arrangements. The orchestration was done by Kyle Gordon

ctx.x: Okay. Yeah. Well listen I did not orchestrate that music. I composed all the music, I did some of the arrangements. The orchestration was done by Kyle Gordon, who was one of I think five orchestrators for the Oppenheimer film that won an Academy Award. He’s a young — he’s not so young — but yeah, everyone is younger than me. My dad always told me, “Son, always have respect for your elders” but I’m finding it more difficult all the time finding anyone older. But anyways, he’s a great young orchestrator, a graduate…
